newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Australian bonds romp ahead against dlr bloc.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Australian bonds romp ahead against dlr bloc.

text.p: Australian bonds generally outperformed the rest of the dollar bloc for the second day in a row as the expectation mounted that the Reserve Bank will ease policy on Wednesday.

The Australian/U.S. 10-year bond yield spread sank to its lowest level in over week as the local market continued to build on already hefty long positions on the premise that the central bank will lop at least 50 basis points off official 7.0 percent interest rates after today's board meeting.
Today's spread tightening comes in the face of a firm U.S. market ahead of the presidential election and the start of the US$38.5 billion quarterly refunding auctions later today.
Only the short-end of the New Zealand market showed any resilience to the Australia's bullish move amid talk of another dual currency samurai issue linked to the N.Z. dollar.
